The '''F-T6 Rycer''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] which performed in Strikefighter roles. Created in the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of [[Dromund Kalakar]], the fighter was named after the ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rycer]] who served during the [[Great Galactic War]]. As the Empire's finest dogfighter, the Rycer was touted to have improved maneuvering capabilities better than most strikefighters in the galaxy but this came at the price of its defenses.
